title: THE STASH BELT ROW IN THE SAME FOUR GROUPS
why: His answer of 2026-10-13: the career loadout screen in the Undercroft gets the same groups as the raid bar. Build 6c of 8. The belt plan row on the Stash screen now lays its nine keys out in the same four groups with the same labels as the raid bar (GUNS keys 1 to 4, THROW 5 and 6, MEDICAL 7 and 8, ARMOUR 9), and a throwable, medical or armour key he has not bound shows what the floor belt shows on it, dimmed, as the gun keys already do, so the row reads as the keys he will press. A vacant gun key on the raid belt no longer prints a 0. Drawing only.
now: The Stash belt row now shows the same four labelled groups as the raid bar, with the keys the floor belt would fill.
